```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Step 2: Prepare Your Data

Place your vehicle images in the following structure:
```
traffic_data/
├── train/
│ ├── images/
│ │ ├── image1.jpg
│ │ ├── image2.jpg
│ │ └── ...
│ └── labels/
│ ├── image1.txt
│ ├── image2.txt
│ └── ...
└── valid/

 └── labels/
```

Each label file should contain the class index (0=car, 1=bike, 2=truck, 3=bus).

```bash
python -m src.models.train
```

This will:
- Load training and validation data
- Train the CNN model (EfficientNet-B0 by default)
- Save the best model to `models/best_model.pth`
- Save training history to `models/training_history.json`

```bash
python -c "from src.models.evaluate import ModelEvaluator; evaluator = ModelEvaluator(); evaluator.load_model(); print('Model loaded successfully')"
```

```bash
streamlit run app.py
```

- Upload images for classification
- View prediction results with confidence scores
- Process multiple images in batch
- View model evaluation metrics

## Step 6: Make Predictions from Command Line (Optional)

```bash
python -m src.models.predict --image path/to/your/image.jpg
```
